mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, user_limit, storage_limit FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(physical.object_size), 0) FROM ( SELECT MAX(GREATEST(COALESCE(file_size, 0), 0)) AS object_size FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY storage_type, config_id, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(file_path, ''), CAST(file_id AS CHAR)) AS BINARY) FOR UPDATE ) physical
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_tenant SET storage_used = #{usedMb} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
